items.source_excerpt: MAKKAH — The Makkah Mayoralty began accepting applications for the qualification of catering contractors for the 1448 AH (2027) Hajj season, starting Saturday, Rabi Al-Akher 1, corresponding to September 12. This is part of the mayoralty’s early preparations to enhance the readiness of services provided to pilgrims and improve the efficiency of field operations in accordance with the highest standards of quality and food safety.
